Zhipu AI just released GLM‑5.4, the first model to embed a Loop Transformer for code generation and execution.

The model achieves a 48 % pass@1 score on the HumanEval benchmark, narrowing the gap with proprietary coding assistants.

GLM‑5.4 doubles the parameter count of its predecessor to 7.5 B and was trained on 1.2 trillion tokens, with a large portion consisting of code‑execution traces.

“The Loop Transformer enables iterative reasoning over arbitrary execution traces.”  

This architecture lets a single prompt contain an entire program’s run history, reducing the need for separate testing pipelines.

The open‑weight release means developers can self‑host the model, avoiding API limits and privacy concerns.

How will you integrate a model that can write, run, and verify code in one step into your workflow?  

Full breakdown with sources: https://buildwithsaksham.in/blog/glm-5-4-toward-generalized-coding-with-our-first-loop-transf
